purpose: A reproducible Philippine/shared-basin candidate index for prioritizing exact-waterbody source review in Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao.

attribution.citation: Ding, L. (2026). A global geospatial dataset of freshwater fish species at the drainage-basin scale (updated to December 2024) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19511163
attribution.originalFrameworkCitation: Tedesco, P. A. et al. (2017). A global database on freshwater fish species occurrence in drainage basins. Scientific Data, 4, 170141. https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2017.141
attribution.changeNote: Philippines and shared-country basin rows and valid_name-level associations extracted from the cited 2024-updated dataset; only concise structured fields retained, not Catalogue of Fishes narrative text.

extraction.exactNameJoin: CAS.basin token to Basin_202412_3364.dbf basin field

geographicResolution: Drainage-basin association only. No polygon, basin centroid, locality coordinate, river reach, lake shoreline or administrative-region assignment is included.
caveats: These are basin-level distribution candidates synthesized by the source dataset, not dated specimen or observation records.
The basin and country fields are not a complete Philippine surface-water inventory; only basins represented in this version are listed.
Two listed basin polygons include multiple countries; preserve their shared scope and do not treat them as Philippines-only.
The extracted sheet does not supply a native/introduced status field, event date, sampling method, waterbody-specific evidence, or source-level license for each underlying reference.
The source dataset is labeled freshwater fish but broad drainage-basin associations can include brackish or marine-influenced taxa and do not identify the exact habitat within a basin.

Matching n_specs to extracted unique-name counts checks internal consistency between two files in the same Zenodo record; it does not independently validate taxonomy, species presence, basin geometry or local occurrence.
All rows remain research-only. No public species/occurrence rows, fishing recommendations, diet, catchability, safety or rules were added.
